title: CQRS
subtitle: Give reads their own denormalised model, and accept that it trails the writes
motto: Reads and writes want different shapes, so give each its own
coreAddition: separate read model with a projector
keyInsight: Separating the read model makes reads a single cheap lookup and frees the write side, but it is eventually consistent, so a burst of writes can leave readers seeing old data for seconds.

decisions.title: Fail with a write burst
decisions.description: The failure frame sends more writes than the projector can copy, so the read model's lag appears as a backlog with a number of seconds.
decisions.alternatives: Quoting 'eventual consistency' without a number would not show how stale a read can get.

decisions.title: Fix with reading your own writes
decisions.description: The last frame routes a few reads to the write side, and shows the extra write-side load that it costs.
decisions.alternatives: Making the projector synchronous would hide the lag but remove the benefit of the split.
